title: 第20章 标枪物美价廉啊第21章 兽人难民以及史莱姆的各种用法
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
“要用力往前刺！”
“你看你们，简直就是一群废物！”
“动作不标准，喊的还没力气！”
“你们是白吃肉菜汤了！”
“一！”
“二！”
“一！”
“二！”
“要这样喊！”
训练场上，艾克雷和他的弟弟格雷，一起训练着民兵们。
由于天气逐渐进入冬天，加上准备过冬的物资已经准备好了，领地下发了冬季训练，防备兽人的要求。
训练无非就两点，一个是学习使用使用长矛，以及在不同情况下结阵。
还有就是投掷石头。
这样的训练可以在未来直接让他们转型成火枪兵以及掷弹兵，简直经济实惠。
正当他们训练的正起劲的时候，阿宁斯贝城外的山上，，城外突然响起一声巨响，吓的众人一跳。
格雷急忙转头。这才看到远处的山上升腾起了硝烟。
格雷：“魔法师？”
艾克雷：“敌袭吗？”
格雷立刻思考：“莉莉姆小姐和林恩大统领在那座山上，不可能是兽人袭击了吧？”
艾克雷：“有可能，如果是林恩大统领的话，这样的威力的魔法他蓄力是可以做到的。”

艾克雷急忙道：“所有教官跟我走，格雷，你留下来指挥他们登上城墙，我们出去后关紧城门，让矮人们赶紧把做好的长矛先拿出来。”
......
当爆炸结束后，林恩从战壕里爬起来感叹道：“异世界超人名不虚传啊，我居然扔出了百米远。”
“在蓝星，大多数人手榴弹都扔不及格，我直接把炸药包扔了上百米。”
蓝星上的手榴弹科目林恩是记得的，男性30米及格，女性20米及格，就这样还有很多人是扔不及格的。
当然，也有一些超人，可以扔出90多米的距离，在穿越前林恩就记得当时的记录好像是有人扔出了上百米，被叫成了人型迫击炮。
有斗气的加持，林恩觉得自己可以把那些有斗气修炼天赋的人，给整成人型迫击炮兵了。
这样的威力超乎林恩想象，如果是使用魔法的话，都能算个大招了。
不过自己可是sss级天赋，不能把自己的标准用到别人身上。
自己是直接扔炸药包，还是木制的。
如果是手榴弹的话，会不会直接有300米呢？
如果改成把木棍中间挖空，塞满火药，当场标枪扔出去会怎么样？
林恩现在已经知道5秒引信要多长了，加上之前的数据，通过计算这样就可以精准把控爆炸时间了。
林恩立刻拿起本子写起了数据。
引信的制作方法就是烟花的引信，勉强能用，把引信藏在炸弹的里面就ok了。
回去看看能不能依靠自己的魔法天赋整出雷管的替代品。
好在自己的这个世界是魔法世界，人口多，法师老爷对火药不屑一顾。
“林恩大统领！”
“莉莉姆小姐！”
“你们没事吧！”

林恩刚刚计算完数据，就听到了有人喊自己，当即回头，发现莉莉姆已经差不多走回来了，就离自己有50米的距离，艾克雷已经跑过来了。
刚到现场，艾克雷就看见了爆炸的痕迹，立刻大声询问：“大统领，敌人在哪里！”
“没有敌人，我实验了一些武器而已。”林恩拿起篮子，就往城里走：“你们有心了，走吧给你们看大宝贝。”
艾克雷以及一众士兵疑惑道：“大宝贝？”
content_en:
"Strike forward hard!"
"Look at you, you are just a bunch of trash!"
"My movements are not standard, and I don't have the strength to shout!"
"You are eating meat and vegetable soup for nothing!"
"One!"
"Two!"
"One!"
"Two!"
"Shout like this!"
On the training ground, Aikere and his brother Gray trained the militiamen together.
As the weather gradually entered winter, and supplies for the winter were already prepared, the territory issued winter training to prepare for the orcs' requirements.
The training is nothing more than two points. One is to learn to use the spear and form formations in different situations.
Then there's the throwing of stones.
This kind of training can directly transform them into musketeers and grenadiers in the future, which is simply economical and affordable.
Just when they were training vigorously, on the mountain outside Aninsberg, a loud noise suddenly sounded outside the city, startling everyone.
Gray turned his head quickly. Only then did I see smoke rising from the mountains in the distance.
Gray: "Magician?"
Ikere: "Enemy attack?"
Gray immediately thought: "Miss Lilim and Commander Lin are on that mountain. It can't be an orc attack, right?"
Aikere: "It's possible. If Commander Lin En is the leader, he can charge up such a powerful magic."
Aikeli hurriedly said: "All instructors, follow me. Gray, you stay and direct them to climb the city wall. After we go out, close the city gate tightly and let the dwarves take out the prepared spears first."
...
When the explosion ended, Linn got up from the trench and sighed: "Superman from another world is well-deserved. I actually threw it a hundred meters away."
"In Blue Star, most people failed to throw grenades. I just threw the explosive package hundreds of meters."
Lin En remembers the grenade subject on Blue Star. Men passed 30 meters and women passed 20 meters. In this way, many people failed to throw.
Of course, there are also some superhumans who can throw it over a distance of more than 90 meters. Before crossing over, Linn remembered that the record at that time seemed to be that someone threw it over a hundred meters and was called a human mortar.
With the blessing of fighting spirit, Lin En felt that he could transform those who had the talent of fighting spirit into human mortar soldiers.
This kind of power was beyond Linn's imagination. If it were using magic, it would be considered a big move.
However, I am a SSS-level talent, so I cannot apply my own standards to others.
Did he throw the explosive package directly, or made it wooden.
If it were a grenade, would it be directly 300 meters away?
What would happen if the middle of the stick was hollowed out, filled with gunpowder, and the javelin thrown out on the spot?
Lin En now knew how long the 5-second fuse was. With the previous data, he could accurately control the explosion time through calculation.
Lin En immediately picked up the notebook and started writing the data.
The method of making the fuse is to use the fuse of fireworks, which is barely usable. Just hide the fuse inside the bomb and it will be ok.
Go back and see if you can use your magic talent to create a replacement for the detonator.
Fortunately, this world of mine is a magical world with a large population, and the Master Wizard disdains gunpowder.
"Commander Lin En!"
"Miss Lilim!"
"Are you okay?"
Lin En had just finished calculating the data when he heard someone calling him. He immediately turned around and found that Lilim had almost walked back, only 50 meters away from him, and Aikere had already run over.
As soon as he arrived at the scene, Ikere saw traces of the explosion and immediately asked loudly: "Commander, where is the enemy!"
"There are no enemies, I just experimented with some weapons." Lin En picked up the basket and walked towards the city: "You guys are interested, let's go and show you the big treasure."
Aikere and a group of soldiers asked in confusion: "Big baby?"
